justification: The garden does not need tending every week, only watching, and this week it told me to leave Mr. Daniels where he's already proven himself rather than return him to the bench out of mere sentiment for Goff, who sleeps a while longer. Warren rises for Barner on the same quiet instruction — not a hunch, just the plain shape of things as they stand today. Pickens carries a Questionable tag, and I have looked for an omen in it; I find none, and no healthy wand waits on my bench to replace him, so he plays, weather or no weather. Taylor, Wilson, Washington, Wilson, Shrader, and Denver's defense all stand where the season has already told me they belong. Nothing dramatic happens in a lineup like this — which is, itself, rather the point.
